details: So sade mode is way too easy to accidentally trigger with index controllers since the index reads the trigger touch as a press using playspace mover to navigate with the buttons. Having a tickbox in VRChat settings to disable it and pushing it as a configurable binding seems like a good solution.
title: An option to rebind or disable safe mode
